name: What's on — events agenda
description: A "What's on" board for hotels, conference venues, campuses and community centres: the next events grouped by day, today (or tonight) large and later days smaller, with times, rooms, speakers and direction arrows. The session in progress is highlighted, finished ones drop off by themselves, and long programmes page. Type the programme in, or connect a calendar (iCal), Google Sheet or Manual table.
author: ScreenTinker

params.name: title
params.label: Title
params.help: The big heading. Leave empty to hide it.

params.name: subtitle
params.label: Subtitle
params.help: One line under the title, for example the venue or event name. Leave empty to hide it.

params.name: footer
params.label: Footer line
params.default: Guest Wi-Fi: Harbourview-Guest  ·  Reception and cloakroom on Level 1
params.help: Small print along the bottom. Leave empty to hide it.

params.name: logo
params.label: Logo
params.help: Optional. Shown beside the title.

params.name: agenda
params.label: Programme (used when no data source is connected)
params.help: One event per line: Date | Start | End | Title | Location | Host | Arrow. Date is 2026-10-12, or +0 for today, +1 for tomorrow. Times like 09:30 or 7pm. See the README.

params.name: events
params.label: Events data source (optional)
params.help: A Calendar (iCal) source, or a Google Sheet, CSV or Manual table with the columns below. When connected it replaces the programme typed above.

params.name: arrow_col
params.label: Sheet column: direction arrow
params.help: Optional. An arrow (← ↑ → ↓ ↖ ↗ ↘ ↙) or a word: left, right, ahead, up, down, up-left, up-right…

params.name: days_ahead
params.label: Days to show
params.help: Today plus the following days. 1 shows today only.

params.name: rows_per_page
params.label: Most events per page
params.help: Per column. Fewer are shown when they would not fit at a readable size; the rest page.

params.name: page_seconds
params.label: Seconds per page
params.help: Only used when the programme does not fit on one screen.

params.name: show_tonight
params.label: Say Tonight in the evening
params.help: Off keeps saying Today all day.

params.name: tonight_hour
params.label: "Tonight" from (hour)
params.help: From this hour the first day is headed with the Tonight text instead of Today.

params.name: today_label
params.label: Text: Today
params.help: Leave empty for the built-in word in the board's language.

params.name: tonight_label
params.label: Text: Tonight
params.help: Leave empty for the built-in word in the board's language.

params.name: tomorrow_label
params.label: Text: Tomorrow
params.help: Leave empty for the built-in word in the board's language.

params.name: now_label
params.label: Text: Now (on the session in progress)
params.help: Leave empty for the built-in word in the board's language.

params.name: show_next
params.label: Tag the next session today
params.help: A Next tag and "in 25 min" on the next session that has not started.

params.name: next_label
params.label: Text: Next (on the next session today)
params.help: Leave empty for the built-in word in the board's language.

params.name: all_day_label
params.label: Text: All day
params.help: Leave empty for the built-in word in the board's language.

params.name: empty_label
params.label: Text when nothing is scheduled
params.help: Leave empty for the built-in word in the board's language.

params.name: timezone
params.label: Timezone
params.help: The venue's timezone. Leave empty to use the screen's own clock.

params.name: locale
params.label: Language
params.help: The board's words, days, dates and times, e.g. en-GB or de-DE. Empty = the screen's language. Calendar days and times are shown in it too; give the calendar the venue's timezone.
